correctness.rationale: For the specified GP(10,2), an independent support is necessary because the all-positive trace on an adjacent pair is impossible. An independent set is inclusion-maximal exactly when it dominates every unselected vertex. Testing all independent supports against the resulting full concept set via the cardinality of their traces is exact. Single-vertex extensions suffice to find facets by downward closure. The independent replay over all 2^20 masks gave 295 concepts, face counts (1,20,160,660,1470,1572,310,0,0) by cardinality, and facets 10,672,310 at cardinalities 4,5,6. BFS tested all four-sets and verified equality, not just equal count, with the ten sets of pairwise distance three. The exact augmented mod-two boundary ranks (1,19,141,519,941,305) and the chain condition give reduced Betti numbers 10,326,5 in degrees 3,4,5, and zero otherwise. The last consistency check at RESULT.md line 41 uses cardinality signs on both sides: its -311 is the negative of the conventional reduced Euler characteristic, which is +311. This does not change the homology statement.

value.rationale: The maximal-extension trace constraint has genuine geometry beyond the independence complex. For this standard symmetric cubic graph the result quantifies the gap, identifies the ten exceptional smallest facets by distance rather than merely by enumeration, and gives nonzero homology in three consecutive degrees. Those are useful exact comparison data for shattering by independent dominating sets on symmetric graphs.
